meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 审计代码库在架构、一致性、类型、测试、依赖、性能、错误处理、安全、文档九个维度上的技术债;每条发现会注明文件位置、严重程度和预计工时,最后写成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,并按优先级给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当请求含 tech debt、code health 等关键词,或要求做技术债审计、代码库健康检查或架构审查时接管。

say.text: 帮我把项目里的技术债全部审计一遍。
查一下代码库里有哪些高风险问题。
say.note: 会按严重级别分级,并标出文件行号。

say.text: 哪些地方半小时内就能清理干净?
say.note: 会列出 Quick Wins 清单。

howto.what_en: Audits code for technical debt across nine areas. Each finding cites file location, severity and effort hours, then lands in TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with prioritized recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you use terms like tech debt or code health, or ask for a tech-debt audit, codebase health check, or architecture review.

say_en.text: Audit all technical debt in this project.
say_en.note: Runs the audit and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md.

say_en.text: Find high-risk issues in this codebase.
say_en.note: Ranks findings by severity with file:line citations.

say_en.text: What can be cleaned up in under 30 minutes?
say_en.note: Lists the quick wins from the audit.
